message: The first codepoint receiver used nul.html as a case filename. Chromium refused the Windows reserved DOS name with net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. Product source remained unchanged. Original bytes renamed to portable reserved-nul-name-input.json and reserved-nul-name-output.html.
